_comment: #508. The latest of the five belt districts: the hill was built out mostly in the 1940s-60s, so
this skews mid-century - plain stucco boxes, wide picture windows, aluminium sliders. Cooler and
greyer than Noe with almost no warm draw, because painted-wood 'painted lady' colour is not what
Consequences for the roles: Accent1 is near-white and a soft grey-green (mid-century trim is a
line, not a colour); Accent2 is a narrow grey-tan ramp for the same reason; Metal is the one
role that goes UP, to a bright aluminium, because the sliders and railings are the era's
signature and should catch the eye. Glass is a touch lighter and bluer to read as a big pane.
Authored, not verified in an Editor.
